No criminalisation and no documented anti-trans violence against visitors. Official posture is hostile: a 2024 policy push against advocacy, a marriage amendment, and no anti-discrimination law. Prosecutorial guidance is a modest positive.

Criminalised and enforced: a health worker imprisoned for three years, forced anal examinations, police bribe extortion, mob violence with police involvement, and a 2022 presidential hate spike. No recourse, and state actors are implicated.
